title: Linear Independence of Polynomial Compositions and Identifiability of Deep Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.27113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Motivated by theoretical problems in deep learning, we conjecture that post-composing a fixed number of pairwise distinct nonconstant polynomials with a generic polynomial of sufficiently large degree yields linearly independent polynomials. This generalizes Newman--Slater's theorem on powers of polynomials. We establish several cases of this conjecture and its origin-passing variant: We prove the result for two polynomials, and for an arbitrary number of polynomials when their degrees are bounded. Furthermore, we show how the conjecture implies a complete understanding of the identifiability (i.e., parameter symmetries) of deep fully connected neural network architectures with generic polynomial activation functions. In particular, for network architectures with layer-specific activations of increasing degree, our established versions of the conjecture fully characterize the set of parameters yielding the same end-to-end network funct

translated_title: 多项式复合的线性独立性与深度神经网络的可辨识性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27113v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：受深度学习理论问题的启发，我们猜想，将固定数量的两两不同的非常数多项式与一个次数足够大的通用多项式进行后复合，会产生线性独立的多项式。这推广了纽曼-斯莱特关于多项式幂的定理。我们证明了该猜想及其“原点传递”变体的若干情形：我们证明了对两个多项式的结果，以及当次数有界时对任意数量多项式的结果。此外，我们展示了该猜想如何实现对具有通用多项式激活函数的深度全连接神经网络架构可辨识性（即参数对称性）的完整理解。特别地，对于具有逐层激活函数且次数递增的网络架构，我们已证明的猜想版本完全刻画了产生相同端到端网络函数的参数集合。
tldr: 本文提出并部分证明了一个关于多项式复合线性独立性的猜想，并展示了它如何完全解决具有多项式激活函数的深度神经网络的可辨识性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and partially proves a conjecture on the linear independence of polynomial compositions, showing how it fully resolves the identifiability problem for deep neural networks with polynomial activations.
